metadata.title: Ragu Bolognese (Lentils Ragù)
metadata.description:
TIMES, YIELD and INFO:
Makes: 5-6 portions (1kg - 2.2lb)
Preparation time: 15 minutes
Cooking time: 35 minutes

INGREDIENTS (US):
1 clove of garlic
1 carrot (4oz)
1 stalk of celery (3oz)
1 medium white onion (4oz)
3⁄4 cup tomato sauce (4oz)
1 pint dashi or vegetable stock
1⁄2 cup soy milk or any other dairy free milk (4oz)
1 1⁄4 cup small dried lentils - possibly brown or black (4oz)
1 rosemary sprig
4 sage leaves
salt to taste

When measuring ingredients, make sure that all the measurements are level. This means discarding the ingredients that rise above the rim of the measuring cup, tsp, tbsp .etc. The back of a knife works perfectly for this.

INGREDIENTS (Metric):
1 clove of garlic 130g carrots
90g celery
130g white onion 120g tomato sauce
500g dashi or vegetable stock
120g soy milk or any other dairy free milk
120g dried lentils - small brown or black
1 rosemary sprig
4 sage leaves
salt to taste

The main portion of the video shows the ingredients being chopped on a wooden cutting board and then cooked in a large pot. The dish is shown being plated in the end with a photo. summary.brief: A vegan lentil ragù is prepared, simmered, and served over spaghetti.
summary.detailed: The video opens with a still picture of the finished spaghetti topped with a red lentil ragù. A presenter in a white outfit then chops garlic, carrot, celery, onion and fresh herbs on a wooden cutting board. The chopped vegetables are placed into a large pot on the stove, a small amount of oil is added, and they are sautéed until the onions become soft and translucent. Dried lentils are added, followed by dashi (or vegetable) stock, and the pot is covered and simmered on low heat for about twenty minutes. After the lentils are tender, tomato sauce, rosemary, sage and a splash of non‑dairy milk are stirred in, the mixture is simmered a few more minutes, then the sauce is checked for consistency. The thick ragù is ladled over cooked spaghetti on a white plate, which is shown briefly before end‑card graphics thank the viewers.

action.detailed: Chop the garlic, carrot, celery, onion and herbs; sauté them in a pot with oil, add lentils and stock, simmer until tender, then stir in tomato sauce and non‑dairy milk, simmer briefly, and serve the sauce over spaghetti.

     tool use, packing, sorting. The video must show clear procedural
     manipulation, NOT just incidental hand movement (e.g. a vlog where
     someone holds things while talking does NOT count).
   - "navigation": the camera moves through a physical environment as an
